posts.author: Drakiidesu
posts.body:
Hi everyone,
I’m working on a project in
RPG Maker MZ
and I’m currently using these VisuMZ plugins:
Battlecore
CoreEngine (CorEngine)
Lightning Effects
Weather Effects
Visual Fogs
I’m thinking about adding
PG Maker Action Combat - RPG Maker MZ Plugin
, but before I do, I wanted to ask if anyone here has tried using it alongside these VisuMZ plugins.
Main things I’m wondering:
Are they compatible?
Did you run into any issues or conflicts?
Is there a specific plugin order that works best?
Also, in case this setup doesn’t work well together:
What are the most recommended plugins (by the community in general) for
lighting, weather, and fog
effects in MZ? I don’t mind if they’re paid or free.
Thanks in advance to anyone who takes the time to reply. I really appreciate any advice or experience you can share!
